여덟.forms: native · counting things, hours, age · same before a counter (여덟 개, 여덟 시)
여덟.x: Eight friends came to the party.
여덟.t: Pronounced [여덜]: the ㅂ in the ㄼ batchim is silent.

밑.x: The cat is under the bed.
밑.e: Directly underneath or the bottom: 책상 밑 = under the desk.

돕다.forms: 도와요 · 도왔어요 · 도울 거예요 · 도우세요 (ㅂ irregular)
돕다.x: I help my mother with her work every weekend.
돕다.t: ㅂ irregular: ㅂ becomes 오/우 — 돕다 is one of the few that become 와: 도와요.

노랗다.x: Ginkgo leaves are yellow in autumn.
노랗다.e: 노란색 = the color yellow. The ㅎ drops: 노란 옷.

상처.ex: 자전거를 타다가 넘어져서 다리에 상처가 났어요.
상처.x: I fell off my bike and got a cut on my leg.
상처.t: 상처를 받다 means 'to have your feelings hurt,' and 상처를 주다 means 'to hurt someone.'

영하.ex: 내일 아침은 영하 십 도까지 떨어져요.
영하.x: Tomorrow morning it will drop to ten below zero.
영하.t: The opposite is 영상 'above zero'; forecasts say 영상 3도 for 3°C.

버릇.x: I have a habit of biting my nails.
버릇.e: Native word; 버릇없다 (no manners) describes rude, spoiled behavior.

학부모.m: parent(s) of a student, school parents
학부모.x: There's a parents' meeting at school tomorrow.

성질.m: temper, disposition; nature, property (of a thing)
성질.ex: 그 사람은 성질이 급해서 자주 화를 내요.
성질.x: He's quick-tempered, so he often gets angry.
성질.t: About people, 성질 usually means temper: 성질이 나쁘다 = bad-tempered, 성질을 내다 = to blow up.

송편.x: The day before Chuseok, I made songpyeon with my family.
송편.e: 송 'pine' + 편 'rice cake' — steamed on a bed of pine needles.
송편.t: You shape songpyeon by hand: 송편을 빚다. An old saying goes that if you make pretty songpyeon, you'll have a pretty daughter.

식혜.x: At a jjimjilbang, sikhye with baked eggs is the best.
식혜.t: Pronounced [시켸] or [시케]. Made by steeping cooked rice in malt water, served cold with grains of rice floating in it.

영상 통화.forms: 영상 통화가 · 영상 통화를 · verb: 영상 통화하다
영상 통화.ex: 주말마다 고향에 계신 부모님과 영상 통화를 해요.
영상 통화.x: Every weekend I have a video call with my parents back home.
영상 통화.e: 영상 'video, image' (literally 'reflected image') + 통화 'phone call' (literally 'talk passing through').
영상 통화.t: Make a video call: 영상 통화를 하다 or 영상 통화를 걸다. 화상 통화 means the same and is a slightly older, more formal term.

악화.ex: 치료를 미루면 병이 악화될 수 있어요.
악화.x: If you put off treatment, the illness can get worse.
악화.t: Pronounced [아콰] — ㄱ and ㅎ merge into ㅋ.

동지.x: There's a custom of eating red bean porridge on the winter solstice.
동지.e: Literally 'winter's extreme' — the longest night of the year.
동지.t: Homonym: another 동지 means 'comrade'; context makes it clear.

낙관.ex: 아직 경기 결과를 낙관하기는 조금 이릅니다.
낙관.x: It's still a little early to be optimistic about the game's outcome.

당분간.m: for the time being, for a while
당분간.ex: 공사 때문에 당분간 이 길을 이용할 수 없습니다.
당분간.x: This road will be closed for the time being due to construction.

극심하다.x: An extreme drought continued this summer.
극심하다.t: Pronounced [극씸하다]; mostly for bad things like 극심한 고통, 극심한 교통 체증.

탁월하다.x: This medicine works extremely well for colds.
탁월하다.t: Pronounced [타궐하다]. Often with 능력, 선택, 효과: 탁월한 선택 'an excellent choice'.

낙하산.m: parachute appointment, someone placed in a job through connections; parachute
낙하산.ex: 새로 온 사장이 낙하산이라는 소문이 돌았어요.
낙하산.x: There was a rumor that the new president got the job through connections.
낙하산.e: Literally 'falling-down umbrella', a parachute; used for people dropped into jobs from above.
낙하산.t: Pronounced [나카산]; 낙하산 인사 is the standard news phrase for this practice.

일맥상통.m: having something in common, being in line with
일맥상통.ex: 두 사람의 생각은 일맥상통하는 부분이 있어요.
일맥상통.x: The two people's ideas have something in common.
일맥상통.e: Literally 'one vein running through both' — a shared thread.

심사숙고.x: After careful thought, I decided to quit my job.

암기식.x: It's hard to develop creativity through rote-memorization education.
암기식.e: -식 = style or method: 암기식, 토론식, 한국식.

입원실.x: Grandma is in a hospital room on the hospital's third floor right now.

딱지치기.ex: 딱지치기에서 지면 딱지를 친구에게 줘야 해요.
딱지치기.x: If you lose at ddakji, you have to give your tile to your friend.
딱지치기.t: Pronounced [딱찌치기]. You slam your tile onto the other player's; if theirs flips over, you win it.

각하.m: dismissal (of a suit without review on the merits)
각하.ex: 법원은 요건을 갖추지 못한 소송을 각하했습니다.
각하.x: The court dismissed the lawsuit because it failed to meet the requirements.
각하.e: Literally 'reject down'; the homonym 각하 also means 'Your Excellency'.
각하.t: Don't confuse with 기각: 각하 throws a case out on procedure, while 기각 rejects it after review.

공모주.ex: 요즘 공모주 청약에 젊은 투자자들이 많이 몰립니다.
공모주.x: These days, lots of young investors are flocking to apply for IPO shares.
공모주.e: Literally 'publicly recruited stock' — shares offered to the public in an IPO.
공모주.t: Key collocation: 공모주 청약 'applying to buy IPO shares.'

득표율.m: share of the vote, percentage of votes won
득표율.x: He won 60% of the vote in this election.
득표율.e: Literally 'rate of ballots gained'. -율/률 = rate: 투표율, 실업률.
득표율.t: Use 율 after a vowel or ㄴ (득표율, 비율) and 률 elsewhere (실업률).

대인기피증.m: anthropophobia, fear of people, avoiding social contact
대인기피증.ex: 그는 대인기피증 때문에 몇 달 동안 집 밖에 안 나갔어요.
대인기피증.x: Because of his fear of people, he didn't leave the house for months.
대인기피증.e: Literally 'condition of shunning and avoiding face-to-face people'.
대인기피증.t: Often used loosely in daily talk for 'I just don't want to see anyone right now'.

한스럽다.m: to be deeply regrettable, full of sorrow and resentment
한스럽다.x: I deeply regret never having taken good care of my mother.
한스럽다.e: 한 'deep sorrow' + -스럽다 'feeling like': feeling full of han.

증후군.ex: 새 학기가 되면 새 학기 증후군을 겪는 학생이 많아요.
증후군.x: Lots of students go through 'new semester syndrome' when classes start.
증후군.e: Literally 'a group of symptoms and signs.'

탈산업화.ex: 탈산업화로 많은 공장 도시가 어려움을 겪었습니다.
탈산업화.x: Many factory towns struggled because of deindustrialization.

삼인칭.ex: 삼인칭 시점을 쓰면 여러 인물의 이야기를 보여 줄 수 있어요.
삼인칭.x: With a third-person point of view, you can show several characters' stories.
삼인칭.e: Literally 'three person-label' — he, she or they.

자애롭다.x: The mother looked at her child with loving eyes.
자애롭다.e: Literally 'merciful love'; -롭다 turns it into an adjective.
자애롭다.t: Typically describes parents, grandparents or rulers looking down with kindness.

뭉근하다.x: I simmered the soup over low heat for a long time.

층위.ex: 이 문제는 여러 층위에서 분석해야 해요.
층위.x: This issue needs to be analyzed on several levels.
